description: This file contains extension methods for configuring streaming capabilities in Orleans silo and client builders, including support for persistent streams and stream filters.

classes.name: SiloBuilderStreamingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring streaming support on Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: AddStreaming
methods.description: Enables streaming support on the silo builder by adding necessary services.

methods.name: AddPersistentStreams
methods.description: Configures the silo to use persistent streams with the specified provider name, adapter factory, and configuration.

methods.name: AddStreamFilter<T>
methods.description: Adds a stream filter of type T to either the silo or client builder with the specified name.
